purpose: Receipt of user-approved generic exclusion hash rules; no source data or study results.

public_record_sha256.pile: UTF-8 bytes of the original text field, without whitespace stripping or chat-template rendering. Missing or null text is treated as an empty string; non-string non-null values are rejected.

finance.field_normalization: Missing/null fields become empty strings. Strip surrounding whitespace from system, user, assistant, instruction, input, output. Empty system becomes null.
finance.user_fallback: If normalized user is empty, use normalized instruction plus two newline characters and normalized input when input is nonempty; otherwise use normalized instruction alone.
finance.assistant_fallback: If normalized assistant is empty, use normalized output.
finance.serialization: JSON array [system, user, assistant], serialized with Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon), ensure_ascii=False), then UTF-8 encoded. No JSON formatting spaces or trailing newline. The public-record hash does not use chat-template rendering.
finance.validity: Reject records with empty final user or assistant content.

final_sequence_sha256.selection: First 128 final rendered token IDs, including BOS at position 0, in order; distinct from the public-record hash.
final_sequence_sha256.encoding: 128 signed 32-bit integers, little-endian in the producing environment, contiguous C-order raw bytes (512 bytes); no shape, dtype, file header, separator, or text encoding is included.
final_sequence_sha256.implementation: torch.tensor(list(token_ids[:128]), dtype=torch.int32).numpy().tobytes(order="C"); uses native endianness, verified little-endian for this producer.
final_sequence_sha256.boundary: Includes BOS and 127 subsequent IDs; excludes the rest of the 192-token capture.

verification: Rechecked generic producer and panel-preparation code only; no source records, token values, hidden data, or evaluator payloads were opened.
scope: Generic conventions only; contains no per-record hashes, identities, examples, results, or private provenance.
